description: Exemplar against the in-house baseline reviewer on the same PRs (FR-X8, spec §12.5). Baseline findings are stored in shadow, never posted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.caller AS "Reviewer", count(DISTINCT (r.repo, r.pr_number, r.head_sha)) AS "PR heads",
  count(f.id) AS "Findings", round(count(f.id)::numeric / nullif(count(DISTINCT (r.repo, r.pr_number, r.head_sha)), 0), 2) AS "Per head",
  round(sum(DISTINCT r.cost_usd)::numeric, 2) AS "Cost USD"
FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN rule_runs rr ON rr.review_id = r.id LEFT JOIN findings f ON f.rule_run_id = rr.id
WHERE r.caller IN ('production', 'baseline') AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
  AND (r.repo, r.pr_number, r.head_sha) IN (SELECT repo, pr_number, head_sha FROM reviews WHERE caller = 'baseline')
GROUP BY r.caller ORDER BY 1

title: Exemplar: baseline comparison
